name: Kildeverket — heal the Olsen drift into markup 0.2, then the script-first editor
problemStatement: npm run case:check is green again with tiny-olsen.case.md in markup 0.2 as the single source reproducing today's tiny_olsen_slice.json, and the lab has a working script editor with live compile plus a generated Canvas view
body:
## Decisions so far

- SB-031: the markup patch layer exists — src/compiler/patch.ts (patchField, listFieldAdd/Remove, appendBlock, removeBlock), pure over parseCaseText, single-line splices, byte-identical no-ops. Details on the ticket.
- SB-030: STATUSRAPPORT got its own kind template (content-hugging 700x400 half-sheet), not a RAPPORT alias — tall min-heights bake blank bottoms. doc_status bakes; 9 docs / 7 kinds.
- SB-032: the canvas inspector edits — per-kind forms commit via patchField → localStorage draft (script-editor key, drafts cross surfaces) → rebuild with selection preserved → POST /__save-case. Block diagnostics inline.
- SB-033: edges are authored by drag, deleted by select+Delete; one RELATION legality table; condition edits validate against the §6 grammar and refuse rather than write a broken predicate.
- SB-034: node create/duplicate/delete with an inbound-reference warning before any write; sticky layout — positions per node id in localStorage, barycenter only on first load or explicit 're-layout'.
- SB-035 (research): weave on the canvas — recommended a weave editor pane off conversation-level nodes. Superseded by the SB-037 ruling below.
- Editor language (Terje, 2026-08-06): chrome is English; only case content is Norwegian. TILTAK stays (markup keyword). Norwegian chrome from SB-034 translated.
- SB-036 (probe verdict): NO — the canvas as built is a form bolted on a diagram, not THE editor. Real authoring is linear and fluid, document-first. DD-003 is under review: research SB-038 → grill SB-040 decide the authoring model; SB-037 (weave surface) now waits behind that.
- SB-039: the blank-inspector-after-create bug was Vite reloading on our own save POST (?raw import of the case file); caseSave now suppresses that hot update. Chrome sweep done, fact form got Domain + placeholders, ports named in the legend.
- SB-038 (research): the fluidity consensus across Twine/Yarn/inklewriter/Blueprints — writing creates structure (unknown id in a field → stub node, wired), loose ends are a visible worklist, drag-wire-to-empty-space spawns a filtered create menu, comment boxes + fuzzy jump carry the 80+ node overview, and canvas/script are two lenses on one file. Full findings + steal shortlist on the ticket; feeds grill SB-040.
- SB-040 (grill, Terje): the editor is a hybrid — two surfaces, one store. Script surface (raw markup, live-compiled) is where authoring starts; the canvas wires and navigates; cross-jump both ways. Both surfaces create with their native gesture (naming → wired stub in text, drag-wire-to-empty → filtered menu on canvas); blank-form create dies. Facts are born by select-to-lift from document text. DD-003 amended and retitled. Four rulings on the ticket; fog graduated to SB-041..045.
- SB-037 (grill, Terje): weave surfacing — the SB-035 pane is REJECTED, the node half is kept. Conversation-level nodes (chat/call/recipe/proposal) go on the main board with fact edges both ways; clicking one jumps to the block in the script surface. No pane, no editable sub-board forms. A read-only Blueprints-style sub-canvas branch map is an open feel question → probe SB-047. Build ticket: SB-046 (behind SB-041).

- SB-042: canvas create is drag-wire-to-empty — release a port drag on empty canvas → RELATION-filtered menu (plus document→fact) → node born at the drop point, wired, focus in its first field. Endpoint ports refuse. The n/blank-form create is deleted; canvas document creation moved to the script lens.
- SB-041: the canvas page is the hybrid editor — the CodeMirror lens extracted (script-editor/lens.ts) and mounted beside the canvas over one buffer; shared drafts, both save paths; cross-jump both ways with a bounce guard, sticky board under typing. Feel gate: SB-048. Fog graduated: SB-049 (stubs invisible on canvas — naming only half-works until they render).

- SB-048 (probe verdict, Terje): the hybrid loop HOLDS — script-pane writes land on the canvas without reshuffle, create-by-naming works, cursor-follow pacing and both save rhythms feel right. The canvas PRESENTATION fails: lane view too large/unwieldy → layout probe SB-051 (behind field-cull grill SB-050); nodes carry too many fields → SB-050; drag-create should insert next to same-kind siblings → SB-052; lens tab buttons inconsistent → SB-053. Script pane needs no outline/preview rails.
- SB-050 (grill, Terje): the field cull is a MARKUP cull, not a face cull. Drop the dead six (fact Card:, question Card sub, fact About, bare Leads:, Appears on, recipe gate:); drop Discuss entirely (false per-person gate); Category stays required as the evidence channel (TERM-002), Domain goes optional with the drop deferred; hypothesis Opens owns the tiltak edge, tiltak Needs/Needs hypothesis die. Implementation → SB-054; SB-051 and new provenance probe SB-055 run on culled fields. Closing finding: the real authoring pain is invisible field consequence → SB-055.

- SB-054 (task): the SB-050 cull is live in compiler + lab + core-loop — dead six rejected via fixit-field-culled, Discuss gone end to end, Domain optional, tiltak gate now derived as the inverse of hypothesis Opens. case:check green again (also closes SB-056); reverse gap filed as SB-057 (sim reads question frank_response, no field emits it).
- SB-052 (task): drag-wire create lands the new block after its last same-kind sibling (document anchors past its fact run); end-of-file only when the kind has no sibling.
- SB-053 (task): both lens topbars read Script | Canvas | Pacing | Playtest — the canvas view's "Editor" label is gone.
- SB-057 (task): question blocks gain `Frank: «…»` → frank_response — the sim read is live (case_engine falls through fact → question on card play), so the field returns per the field-returns-when-a-reader-exists law. Sparse emit keeps the shipped JSON byte-identical.

- SB-055 verdict (2026-08-09): game-surface previews + the computed 'what opens this?' sentence PASS — authoring is 'closer to not being guesswork'. Remaining pain is content junk, not surfaces; overview routes through the SPRINT-002 playtest lens and the new ⌘K jump. Reopen only if more features are needed.
- SB-051 verdict (2026-08-09): PIN MODE WINS — force-directed gravity until a drag pins a node (double-click frees); lanes and pure gravity lose. Layout is settled; the remaining board pain is VOLUME, not scatter → scoping probe SB-077 (neighborhood focus / kind filters / grouping frames / fuzzy jump), wired ahead of arrival check SB-045.

## Out of scope

- Weave editor pane and editable sub-board node forms: rejected by the SB-037 ruling.
- Weave patch primitives beyond what jump-to-block needs: deferred until a canvas fact-edge gesture is ticketed.
- Reference cleanup inside prose anchors, effect lines, recipe headers, and or/not/n-of terms: report-only; compiler stub diagnostics catch them.
- Position-store pruning: still unticketed. (Node-body drag-to-reposition landed with SB-051 — the hand/pin modes need it.)
- Auto-suggested fact lifting (LLM/heuristic over document text): a feature on top of the loop, not the loop (SB-040 ruling 3).
- WYSIWYG document-writing mode over the markup: deferred until a probe shows raw-markup prose is the friction (SB-040 ruling 4).

comments.author: claude
comments.text: Research session 2026-08-05 (3 parallel opus agents): SB-020, SB-021, SB-027 all resolved and closed — full findings on the tickets. Headlines: (1) Drift is wider than assumed — 7 top-level JSON sections are un-authorable today, and docs/case-content-runtime.md explicitly tells authors to hand-edit the JSON. 0.2 is the FIRST markup to claim the conversation layer, not an extension of a working emitter. (2) The runtime's choice model is card-drops, not text menus — 0.2 needs first-class card-keyed branch notation. §6 guard grammar is partly disjoint from PredicateSpec (6 terms need new engine ops; 2 shipped ops are missing from the spec). Hubs/diverts/deep nesting have no runtime slot — recommend defer, not warn. (3) Survey: make 'once' a composable modifier, effects fire on traversal, dispatch-table selection with declaration-order tiebreak (Yarn saliency/ChatMapper group+priority) fits card-keying, proposal pairs are genuinely our own construct (linter-required otherwise/soft-reject row), recipes = named condition+effect bundles. Highest-leverage tooling idea: red/green 'why hidden' trace — closed grammar makes it possible; ship before any graph view. Frontier is now the grill (SB-022) alone — next session is HITL, one ticket, hard rule.
